startUrls.title: Source page URLs
startUrls.description: Listing pages to crawl. Each source is crawled across its pagination.

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max requests per crawl
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Upper limit on pages fetched in one run. Keep small while testing.

maxPages.title: Max listing pages per source
maxPages.description: Stop following pagination after this many pages per source. 0 means no limit.

useProxy.title: Use Apify proxy
useProxy.description: Route requests through Apify Proxy. Some sites block datacenter IPs without it.
